tracks.title: First items

tracks.title: Launch readiness
tracks.plain: What must be true before execution starts: documents, setup, reviews, then the native's approval

tracks.title: Track E — Nikaṣa engine

tracks.title: Track A — Analysis, all layers
tracks.plain: Read-only: census, layer plans, asset briefs, fix designs — all six layers at once

tracks.title: Track F — L3 focus families

tracks.title: J1 — The join
tracks.plain: One combined reopen of the founding documents, then the engine freeze

tracks.title: Track I — Implementation
tracks.plain: Fixes for every layer, in parallel lanes

tracks.title: Track B — Rebuild and certify
tracks.plain: One wave per dependency level, in order; certify as each lands
